text:
Aisha: quick async — what I did: drained 4 suspect nodes in eu-west1 (kernel patch), freed ~16 GPUs; spun up 6 temporary p3 nodes in us-central to cover spillover (added ~24 GPUs). Spent a chunk tracing autoscaler jitter 

Tom: thanks. rough question — after the swaps how much headroom do we have in prod pool?

Aisha: prod pool headroom now ~18% (was 5%). Note: high-memory A100 capacity still constrained because us-west2 quota bump is pending.

Marco: blocker then is the quota? ticket #12345 right?

Aisha: yep. blocker: quota escalation for A100s in us-west2 stuck with quota team. Without it we can't shift large-model inference there.

Priya: I submitted the formal justification yesterday (latency and customer impact). Support asked for usage projections — added 7-day burn chart and cost delta. Link: https://console.cloud/quotas/12345 (internal)

Tom: if approval stalls, what's plan B to keep SLOs?

Aisha: plan B = move some heavy routes to dedicated-quant pool and lower batch sizes for long-context inferences. Minimal steps:
```bash
# quick toggle in deployment config
REDWOOD_BATCH_SIZE=16  # current
REDWOOD_BATCH_SIZE=8   # fallback to reduce memory pressure
kubectl rollout restart deploy/llm-inference
```
This should drop OOMs but increases token cost slightly.

Marco: I'll run the spillover smoke test tonight at 22:30 UTC and post perf numbers. I'll follow runbook: /runbooks/gpu-failover (note: update step 3 for new env var).

Priya: update — got provisional approval for 12 A100s in us-west2 for a one-week trial. Need an ops owner to allocate when greenlit.

Tom: I can handle allocation if Priya drops the approved quota ID here.

Priya: approved-quota-id=aq-67890. Dropping in ticket.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: eu-west1 host reboot window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Spot instances may be evicted. See: https://status.redwood.ai/maintenance

Marco: noted — I'll factor that into the spillover test and avoid starting long runs during window.

Aisha: thanks all. Action items: Priya to confirm allocation (PR to infra repo), Marco to run smoke test and post metrics, Tom to stand by for allocation. Ping me if token latency >70% or queue depth >500.

Tom: lgtm

Marco: will report back after test

Priya: on it

Aisha: end of my update, cheers :thumbsup:
